scope: Tests only, limited to the four blocking classes named by Nash/Singer round 194.

blocking_disposition.live_runtime_dataflow: The same production executor required by main is invoked with injected non-GPU operations and must execute exact pack validation, capture, eight recurrence steps, 600 routes, K2/K4/K8 ranking, monotonic stage receipts and canonical publication. Compiled references are supplementary.
blocking_disposition.same_size_pack_and_receipt_authority: A differently named full-size pack is mutated at header, record digest, padding and allowed payload offsets; production pack-open must reject every mutation. The real CLI separately rejects a full-size payload mutation. The builder recomputes every receipt field.
blocking_disposition.candidate_sandbox: An external parent intentionally passes a full-model descriptor, waits at a post-policy barrier, inspects child fds/maps, and requires the descriptor/map absent plus denied model reopen/socket/ptrace/process_vm/unexpected-device probes.
blocking_disposition.crash_safe_publication: An external strace process observes O_EXCL/O_NOFOLLOW staging, actual writes/fsyncs/renameat2, completion-last and directory fsync. It injects ENOSPC/EINTR/short-write/EIO and SIGKILL at every observed write/fsync/rename occurrence; any surviving completion must validate atomically.

deferred_confirmation: After implementation/source/binary freeze, fixed rank fixtures are supplemented with public-random finite vectors. These tests cannot grant the held-out accuracy PASS.
